title: Short-term barrier option price expansion
abstract: arXiv:2610.00340v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We derive a short-maturity expansion for up-and-out put barrier option prices under continuous stochastic volatility when the strike and the barrier approach the spot at the diffusive scale. Assuming joint weak convergence of the normalized terminal return, the relative volatility fluctuation, and the running maximum, together with uniform integrability, we show that the leading term is the time-inhomogeneous Black-Scholes barrier price fitted to the forward variance curve. The first model-dependent correction is of order $\theta^{H+1/2}$, where $\theta^H$, $H \in (0,1/2]$, is the order of the relative volatility fluctuation, and is represented explicitly through killed Brownian transition densities. For regular volatility models, where $H= 1/2$, the coefficient is determined by the short-maturity at-the-money implied-volatility skew. For rough volatility models with $H < 1/2$, the coefficient reduces to a one-dimensional integral. Numer

translated_title: 短期障碍期权价格展开
translated_abstract: 我们在连续随机波动率下推导了向上敲出看跌障碍期权价格的短期限展开式，其中执行价格与障碍价格以扩散尺度趋近于现货价格。在假设归一化终端收益率、相对波动率波动与运行最大值满足联合弱收敛及一致可积性的条件下，我们证明主导项是拟合远期方差曲线的时变Black-Scholes障碍期权价格。首个依赖于模型的修正项阶数为 θ^{H+1/2}，其中 θ^H（H ∈ (0,1/2]）为相对波动率波动的阶数，且该修正项可通过被杀灭布朗运动的转移密度显式表示。对于正则波动率模型（H = 1/2），该系数由短期限平价隐含波动率偏斜决定；对于 H < 1/2 的粗糙波动率模型，该系数可化简为一个一维积分。（原文摘要至此处截断）
tldr: 该论文推导了连续随机波动率下向上敲出看跌障碍期权的短期限价格展开式，证明主导项为拟合远期方差曲线的时变Black-Scholes障碍价格，并给出了由短期平价隐含波动率偏斜（正则波动率模型）或一维积分（粗糙波动率模型）显式确定的首阶模型依赖修正项。
en_tdlr: The paper derives a short-maturity expansion for up-and-out put barrier option prices under continuous stochastic volatility, showing that the leading term is the time-inhomogeneous Black-Scholes barrier price fitted to the forward variance curve, with an explicit first model-dependent correction determined by the short-maturity ATM implied-volatility skew for regular volatility models and reduced to a one-dimensional integral for rough volatility models.
